fieldData.acrm---key-feature-2-content:
A brand lineup with a decoy mixed in

Show your brand among real rivals in random order, plus one plausible brand that does not exist. The share who tick the invented one sets how far to discount every recognition score.
fieldData.awb---integration-feature-2:
One question on the order confirmation page

Right after checkout, Oakhollow's order confirmation page asks one thing: "Where did you first hear about us?" The answer is saved on the order. In September a home design podcast led with 384 of 1,200 answers, ahead of search at 276, and topped the Monday post to the marketing channel.

Chart the two cities side by side and show how much more Denver gained than Omaha.", regionalRecall: "Every quarter, survey 600 pet owners across four regions. fieldData.awb---how-to-step-3-des: Next, show your brand among the rivals buyers weigh in random order, and add one believable brand that does not exist. Anyone who ticks the decoy is overclaiming, and that share tells you how far to discount recognition.
fieldData.asqb---how-to-step-6-des: Run the next wave with the same wording, the same random ordering, and the same screening question. Changing who qualifies or how the category is named moves the score on its own and breaks the comparison with earlier waves.
fieldData.asqb---how-to-step-7-des: Show unprompted and prompted recall for each market beside the previous wave, with the decoy rate next to them. Put the weakest market in front of the person who owns it, and judge the next campaign by whether that number moves.
